comments.body:
The following required metadata fields for MetaArchive bag-info.txt would likely not be useful for a default Fedora bag profile and would necessitate a specific MetaArchive profile:

  • Contact-Name
  • Contact-Phone
  • Contact-Email
  • External-Description
    (full list of metadata: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yWfM9qHCUjT4FMLKX5cwCAPUVUTa9jvsldjmd7kbWfQ/edit?usp=sharing)

Similar to FCREPO-2224 Closed , here is a Bag Profile for MetaArchive:

kestlund Ben Goldman can you review?

{
   "BagIt-Profile-Info":{
      "BagIt-Profile-Identifier":"http://fedora.info/fcrepoMetaArchiveBagProfile.json",
      "Source-Organization":"Duraspace",
      "Contact-Name":"Nick Ruest",
      "Contact-Email":"ruestn@yorku.ca",
      "External-Description":"Default Bag Profile for Fedora and MetaArchive.",
      "Version":"1.2"
   },
   "Bag-Info":{
      "Source-Organization":{
         "required":true
      },
      "Organization-Address":{
         "required":false
      },
      "Contact-Name":{
         "required":true
      },
      "Contact-Phone":{
         "required":true
      },
      "Contact-Email":{
         "required":true
      },
      "External-Description":{
         "required":true
      },
      "External-Identifier":{
         "required":false
      },
      "Bag-Size":{
         "required":true
      },
      "Bag-Group-Identifier":{
         "required":false
      },
      "Bag-Count":{
         "required":false
      },
      "Internal-Sender-Identifier":{
         "required":false
      },
      "Internal-Sender-Description":{
         "required":false
      },
      "Bagging-Date":{
         "required":true
      },
      "Payload-Oxum":{
         "required":true
      }
   },
   "Manifests-Required":[
      "sha1"
   ],
   "Allow-Fetch.txt":false,
   "Serialization":"optional",
   "Tag-Manifests-Required":[
     "sha1"
   ],
   "Accept-BagIt-Version":[
      "0.97"
   ]
}
Nick Ruest Looks good to me.

I've asked MetaArchive if the Bagging-Date requires any particular format.

Also, I am wondering how/when if Fedora can prompt that a bag is over 30GB limit. Is that part of the profile? Even if only a notification that the splitter externally will need to be used.

Otherwise, looks great!
Nick Ruest MetaArchive does not require a specific date format (confirmed by Sam Meister). I recommend ISO 8601 UTC format, which is required by other services.
I've created a draft profile in the initial Bag profile implementation: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/63
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/63 is merged, but I'd like to use this ticket to confirm that the MetaArchive profile is correct.
